name: flightradar-monorepo
description: Flight tracking map built on MeowTileKit

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w meow-open-flight-core && npm run build -w meow-open-flight-airspace
scripts.predev: npm run setup:data && npm run build:packages
scripts.prebuild: npm run setup:data && npm run build:packages
scripts.prestart: npm run setup:data && npm run build:packages
scripts.dist:dir: npm run setup:data && npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @flightradar/web && npm run dist:dir -w @flightradar/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run setup:data && npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @flightradar/web && npm run dist:win -w @flightradar/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w meow-open-flight-core && npm run typecheck -w meow-open-flight-airspace && npm run typecheck -w @flightradar/server && npm run typecheck -w @flightradar/web && npm run typecheck -w @flightradar/desktop
scripts.verify:data: npm run verify:data -w meow-open-flight-core && npm run verify:data -w meow-open-flight-airspace
